blends.name: NFT HORIZON SET 6 REWARD
blends.desc:
NFT HORIZON SET 6 REWARD DESCRIPTION

To get eligible for Set-6, you need to build Set-6 which consists of Patroclus, Diomedes, Odysseus, Ajax, and Achilles, then you need to super-blend them. After blending with the %70 of a chance you will get Ticket II - Midgard Clash, with the %1 of a chance you will get Ticket I - Midgard Clash, and with the %29 of a chance you will get Discordia. After obtaining the tickets, you can get your rewards 1-1 conversions on the Midgard Clash Neftyblocks' super-blend page.

Ticket II - Midgard Clash is used to obtain Promo Chest of Midgard Clash. You can use this ticket on the blend utility at Midgard Clash's Neftyblocks page to get the Promo Chest. Promo Chest contains 5 weapons.

*Achaens Pack Sale (Patroclus-Odysseus-Diomedes): https://neftyblocks.com/c/nfthorizonio/drops/67864

*Achilles & Hephaestus Sale: https://neftyblocks.com/c/nfthorizonio/drops/45723%2B45724

*Ajax on the 2nd market: https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=nfthorizonio&data:text.Rarity=Uncommon&match=ajax&order=asc&schema_name=achaeans&sort=price&symbol=WAX
